ranked.headline: Deep and representation learning models integrate spatial, multiomic, and protein data
ranked.summary: Multi-modal generative, contrastive, and graph models are now applied to spatial transcriptomics, multiomics, and protein function data.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from single-cell, nuclear, and cell-free DNA readouts
ranked.summary: Single-cell and cell-free DNA profiling now resolves enhancer activity, splicing states, and chromatin accessibility QTLs across tissues and disease contexts.

ranked.headline: Computational models map sequence variation to protein-level properties, with validation
ranked.summary: Benchmarking against large experimental datasets now quantitatively tests energy-based and language-model predictions of sequence effects.

ranked.headline: Open-source software now covers pathology, omics, and long-read epigenetic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release installable tools for preprocessing, visualization, and modeling of multimodal biological data.

ranked.headline: Interpretable deep models for DNA sequence-to-function and regulatory prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether sequence-based deep models for regulatory genomics yield interpretable predictions, not just accurate ones.

ranked.headline: Temporal models resolve aging and regulatory dynamics from populations to single cells
ranked.summary: Dense temporal data at population, tissue, and single-cell scales now support dynamical models of aging and gene regulation.

ranked.headline: Feedback and canalization buffer cellular network outputs against perturbation
ranked.summary: Recent modeling studies quantify how feedback, criticality, and network topology buffer cell-state decisions against perturbation.

ranked.headline: Graph models encode chemical structure for property, interaction and reaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work embeds explicit chemical and biological structure in graph-based models for regression, drug repositioning and reaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient deep learning segments electron and microscopy images across scales
ranked.summary: Label-light self-supervised and foundation-model methods now target electron microscopy, cryo-ET, and histology alongside tumour and 3D cell imaging.

ranked.headline: Generative models design target-specific ligands under docking and property objectives
ranked.summary: Six recent items pair generative architectures with explicit scoring functions, physics-based energetics and dynamics-derived representations.

ranked.headline: Machine learning tools classify virus taxonomy, lifestyle, and metagenomic recovery
ranked.summary: Large-scale metagenomic and public genome collections make automated virus taxonomy, lifestyle prediction, and recovery tools essential for expert analysis.

ranked.headline: Sequence analysis tools target misassembly, phasing, ancestry, and ancient viruses
ranked.summary: Reference-free and alignment-free methods are expanding error detection, phasing correction, and ancestry inference directly from sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Language models predict regulatory, variant, and target effects from sequence embeddings
ranked.summary: Pretrained DNA, RNA, and protein language models are being fine-tuned as feature extractors for variant, target, and methylation prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Sequence models predict viral evolution, RNA structure and protein mutational effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published RNA model extend sequence deep learning to viral evolution, RNA structure, and protein binding energetics.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model representations predict drug, ligand, and kinase interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published method pair relational models with language-model embeddings and self-supervised pre-training for biomolecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Open computational tools for microbial pan-genomes, marker selection, and genome…
ranked.summary: Microbial genomics software is automating feature selection, from pan-genome orthologs to signature sequences and phylogenetic markers, alongside accessible…

ranked.headline: MD simulations map dynamic allosteric routes across nucleic acid and protein targets
ranked.summary: Simulation studies now resolve dynamic allosteric routes beyond static structure in RNA-binding, viral, chromatin, and receptor systems.

ranked.headline: Multiscale computational methods resolve spatial tissue organization in transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Xenium, MERFISH and Visium HD generate high-resolution spatial data that call for methods operating across spatial scales rather than fixed-resolution labels.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for processing large, heterogeneous sequence collections
ranked.summary: Deep metabarcoding and expanding genome and gene resources call for reference-independent, benchmarked pipelines that scale to heterogeneous sequence data.

ranked.headline: Generative models design mRNA codon and UTR sequences for higher translation and stability
ranked.summary: Recent publications report generative sequence models producing mRNAs with enhanced translation, expression, and stability in experimental systems.

ranked.headline: Curated benchmarks test computational methods against experimental reference data
ranked.summary: Ablation studies and proteome-scale screens now quantify how individual model components and predictions perform against reference data.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and coarse-grained models extend biomolecular dynamics simulation
ranked.summary: Learned and physics-based surrogates are now applied to kinetics, free energies, large-scale DNA simulation, and multi-particle stochastic dynamics.

ranked.headline: Local rules and disorder shape emergent dynamics in neural, tissue, and condensate systems
ranked.summary: Recent items link local connectivity, feedback rules, and crosslink disorder to dynamic observables across neural, tissue, and condensate systems.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of immunity waning, reinfection, and staged viral budding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model how protection builds and wanes after vaccination and how reinfection and viral budding unfold over time.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link EEG rhythm changes to sleep stages and consciousness disorders
ranked.summary: Complexity measures and individualized biophysical models of EEG are now being applied to sleep, consciousness disorders, and adaptive stimulation.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and embeddings are being used to query and annotate transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Agentic and multimodal LLM interfaces now operate directly on raw single-cell and spatial expression data, not only on fixed analysis pipelines.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict PTM and DIA fragment spectra for proteomics
ranked.summary: Prosit-PTM, Carafe, and Koina extend spectral prediction to modified peptides, experiment-specific libraries, and shared model serving.

ranked.headline: Bootstrap and benchmark tests for learned network differences and inference accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether learned networks differ and benchmarks inference methods on a simulated lipidomics network.

ranked.headline: Whole metagenome sequencing recovers ~60% of modeled microbiome function at full depth
ranked.summary: Recent preprints quantify how far metagenomic sequencing recovers microbial function and supply probe and genome-resolved tools for complex communities.

ranked.headline: Model-based prioritization of therapeutic targets from mechanistic and AI-driven models
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and LLM-agent models now nominate explicit, testable intervention candidates for computational and experimental follow-up.

ranked.headline: Comparative animal genomes reveal convergent gene loss in land colonization
ranked.summary: Large-scale genome comparisons across gibbons, 154 animal genomes, and 22 mammal alignments now resolve deep evolutionary history.

ranked.headline: Anisotropic and fluid-coupled models link tissue mechanics to organ-scale deformation
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now tie organ-scale deformation and fluid behavior to regional and directional material properties.

ranked.headline: Tools for estimating and benchmarking parameters of biochemical and gene network models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple parameter estimation and benchmark simulation to specific network models, including HPC workflows and steady-state constraints.

ranked.headline: Constraint-guided diffusion and structure hallucination for protein design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple diffusion and hallucination generators with explicit structural or stability constraints for binder and sequence design.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and automating docking and QC/MM simulation of biomolecular complexes
ranked.summary: Recent PROTAC ternary-complex docking benchmarks and automated GUI-driven workflows lower barriers to structure-based screening and hybrid simulation.
